{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Jafan III'' flight attendant}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''unidentified flight attendant''' worked on the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Jafan III]]''. In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the flight attendant notified a passenger, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], that someone had requested his presence in the [[Hanna City Spaceport|starport]] terminal.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
